item.text: Create a consistent “closing shift” ritual: save your work, write tomorrow’s top three tasks, and shut the laptop. Clear the table completely, even if only into a basket, then wipe the surface to signal a reset. Change the lighting, play a particular song, or make tea reserved for evenings. Step outside for a five-minute walk or stretch. Finally, change clothes or wash your hands and face—small physical cues that tell your brain work is over.
